$comment: D-RUNTIME-MAIN-ENVP-ENTRY-SHAPE: `main` + `wmain` in one program BUILDS and RUNS `main` on every format that does not realize the `argc-wargv` verb. Before candidate selection became format-aware this source was REFUSED on every target as an ambiguous entry (MEASURED 2026-08-10 on HEAD 3e86a187: K_SymbolUndefined 'ambiguous user-entry', citing D-CSUBSET-MULTI-FN-WIN64-CC -- a code about a symbol that does not exist and an anchor about calling conventions, for a condition where two entries do exist). Selection now intersects the LANGUAGE's declared entry rows with the FORMAT's declared `entryVerbs`, so `wmain` is a candidate only where a wide argument vector can actually be produced. * THE EXIT CODE IS THE WITNESS: main returns 4, wmain returns 7, so a wrong selection is a DISTINCT observable (exit 7) rather than a crash. * THE pe64 HALF IS A SEPARATE EXAMPLE ON PURPOSE: pe64 realizes both verbs, so the identical source is REFUSED there as ambiguous -- see entry_main_and_wmain_ambiguous_pe. Neither example alone states the claim; the claim is that candidacy is per-format DATA. * RED-ON-DISABLE: add "argc-wargv" to elf64-x86_64-linux-exec.format.json's `entryVerbs` and this example stops building, because two candidates then survive on ELF too.

optimizedPipelines.$commentByteIdentical: MEASURED 2026-08-15 — optimized image BYTE-IDENTICAL to the baseline on: arm64:elf64-aarch64-linux-exec, x86_64:elf64-x86_64-linux-exec. Legs actually run: windows/pe64-x86_64 and linux/elf64 (x86_64 + aarch64 under qemu); the darwin/macho64 leg was NOT run. Where the image is identical the arm's exit-code/stdout comparison is x==x and cannot fail. HONEST: after lowering, this program is already minimal — a constant return with no redundancy, no dead block and no promotable local — so every pass in the named set is a no-op on it. Both entry points are a bare constant return; the example pins entry-point SELECTION. Deliberately NOT given "mustDifferFromBaseline" — an honest no-op, not a missed opt-in.
